title: Chain of Thrones
tagline: Chain of Thrones is an onchain strategic pvp wargame where players deploy armies, negotiate collaboration, and battle for the first to control 3 of 5 castles.
description:
Chain of Thrones is an onchain strategy pvp wargame that immerses players in a simplified geopolitics simulation. Designed for 2-3 players, each participant stakes 10 USDC as their starting armies and vies to control 3 of 5 key castles on a 3x3 grid. 
Players move armies, negotiate strategic loans, and resolve conflicts using a mix of deterministic logic and occasional randomness, simulating the unpredictability of real-world geopolitics. Fully autonomous AI can drive gameplay, making Chain of Thrones an engaging and tactical challenge for both human and automated competitors.
how_its_made:
Chain of Thrones is built as an onchain pvp wargame. Max of 2-3 players can play the game and the first to conquer 3 out of 5 castles will win. 

Dynamic: Chain of Thrones is built with a dynamic and modular stack that prioritizes flexibility and ease of use, making it accessible for players and developers alike. By leveraging modern blockchain frameworks, the game ensures seamless integration with popular wallets, enabling players to onboard with just a few clicks. The intuitive interface simplifies gameplay mechanics, allowing new users to dive into the action without needing extensive prior knowledge of blockchain or onchain mechanics. This combination of a dynamic stack and user-friendly design makes Chain of Thrones approachable and engaging for all.

Lit protocol: Chain of Thrones integrates Lit Protocol to ensure secure and transparent gameplay through advanced encryption and access control. Using Lit’s capabilities, all player decisions—such as loan negotiations and movement strategies—are encrypted and protected by flexible access control rules. This ensures that actions remain private and inaccessible until the resolution phase. Once the round’s timeout ends, Lit Protocol decrypts and reveals all actions simultaneously, preserving fairness and strategic integrity. Additionally, the integration of privacy-preserving and verifiable AI agents enhances trust and gameplay dynamics, creating a seamless and secure gaming experience.

Phala: Chain of Thrones leverages Phala Network’s TEE to ensure privacy and fairness in player interactions. All negotiations and movement decisions are securely processed within the TEE, keeping them private and inaccessible to other players during the gameplay phase. Once the round ends, the all actions will be revealed simultaneously, ensuring transparency while preserving the strategic secrecy of each player’s moves. By using TEE for sensitive game mechanics, Chain of Thrones guarantees both data privacy and verifiable outcomes, creating a secure and trustworthy gaming environment.

Curveguid: We leverage Curvegrid's MultiBaas platform on the middleware development of Chain of Thrones, to support frontend calling contract.
